market.question: Will the highest temperature in Madrid be 20°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Met Office forecast for Madrid-Barajas on May 8 is high of 18°C (~64°F). Bucket '20°C' (likely 20.0-20.9°C) sits ~2°C above forecast; probability the actual high lands precisely in that bin is low, though forecast error of ±1-2°C keeps it non-zero. Market 0.21 looks rich.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Warmer-than-forecast surge from a southerly flow could push above 19-20°C.
